skill.name: run-tests
skill.description: Runs Catalyst-Relay unit tests, Node import checks, and optional SAP integration tests using Bun and project test scripts.
skill.summary: Run Catalyst-Relay unit, compatibility, and SAP integration tests.
skill.author: Artisan-Edge

security_audit.summary: Most Markdown backtick detections are false positives from code fences, tables, and inline file names. Confirmed risks remain around local test execution, credential handling, and live SAP integration tests. The highest concerns are command-line password exposure and tests that may change an external SAP system.

remediation.issue: Password can be passed as a command argument.
remediation.suggestion: Remove command-line password examples. Use a secure prompt, OS keyring, or environment injection that avoids shell history and process lists.

remediation.issue: Integration tests connect to a live SAP system.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before live integration tests and document that only sandbox SAP systems should be used.

remediation.issue: The skill can use .env and OS keyring credentials.
remediation.suggestion: Ask users to confirm the credential source before running tests and ensure test output never prints resolved secrets.

remediation.issue: Test commands execute local repository code.
remediation.suggestion: Tell users to run the skill only in trusted checkouts after dependency review or inside an isolated development environment.

content.value_statement: Teams need a repeatable way to verify Catalyst-Relay changes before release. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through unit, compatibility, and integration test steps.
actual_capabilities: Runs all Catalyst-Relay unit tests with Bun.
Supports Bun watch mode for active development.
Runs targeted tests for specific source directories.
Checks Node.js import compatibility before publishing.
Guides SAP integration test setup using environment variables or keyring credentials.
Identifies coverage areas for ABAP, CDS, discovery, search, data preview, and upsert workflows.
limitations: Integration tests require valid SAP system access.
The skill does not create credentials or configure SAP permissions.
Commands must run inside a trusted Catalyst-Relay checkout.
Live integration tests may change external SAP resources.

use_cases.title: Pre-commit Verification
use_cases.description: Run the unit suite after a code change and review any failures before committing.

use_cases.title: Release Readiness Check
use_cases.description: Run full tests and the Node import check before publishing a Catalyst-Relay release.

use_cases.title: SAP Integration Validation
use_cases.description: Confirm integration behavior against an approved SAP test system with known credentials.

prompt_templates.title: Run All Tests
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner verification after a small change.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the Catalyst-Relay unit tests and summarize failures with file names and next steps.

prompt_templates.title: Watch Tests While I Edit
prompt_templates.prompt: Start the Bun watch test workflow for the area I am editing and report new failures as they appear.

prompt_templates.title: Check Publish Compatibility
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the Node.js compatibility import check and explain any import errors in plain language.

prompt_templates.title: Validate SAP Integration Safely
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced integration testing with external credentials.
prompt_templates.prompt: Before running integration tests, confirm the SAP target and credential source. Then run the approved tests and report possible side effects.

output_examples.output: Unit tests completed. One workflow test failed in the changed area. The failure points to a missing expected field.

output_examples.input: Check whether this package is ready to publish.
output_examples.output: The test suite passed, but the Node import check failed. The package needs an export path fix before release.

output_examples.input: Run SAP integration tests for the approved sandbox.
output_examples.output: The SAP target was confirmed before execution. Integration tests finished with one upsert failure and no printed credentials.

best_practices: Review the SAP target before any integration test run.
Use keyring or secure prompts instead of command-line passwords.
Run targeted tests first, then run the full suite before release.
anti_patterns: Do not run live integration tests against production systems.
Do not pass SAP passwords as command arguments.
Do not ignore failed compatibility checks before publishing.

faq.question: What test runner does this skill use?
faq.answer: It uses Bun for Catalyst-Relay unit tests and project test workflows.

faq.question: Can it run only one test area?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports targeted test runs for specific directories or workflow areas.

faq.question: Does it require SAP credentials?
faq.answer: Only integration tests require SAP credentials. Unit tests and import checks do not need them.

faq.question: Should I pass a SAP password on the command line?
faq.answer: No. Use a keyring, secure prompt, or another method that avoids command history exposure.

faq.question: Can integration tests affect real systems?
faq.answer: Yes. They connect to a live SAP system and may change test resources.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
